items.author: Serge Lechenne; Hugo Paquet

items.difficulty_reason: The author reconstructs every symmetry-preserving map from a strict natural transformation on event-structure hom setoids by evaluation at the underlying event structure identity. Naturality over configuration inclusions and isomorphisms proves the reconstructed map preserves the original isomorphism family, and uniqueness of modifications supplies the inverse functor on hom categories. This enriched 2-categorical density construction supports H2 independently of the earlier multiplicity-count proposition.
